title: Pokemon Truck mall schedules in Manila
summary: All aboard the Pokemon truck! The Pokémon Company is pleased to announce that the Pokémon Truck will begin its tour of Metro Manila on October 2. The truck welcomed more than 250,000 visitors in…

blocks.text: The Pokémon Company is pleased to announce that the Pokémon Truck will begin its tour of Metro Manila on October 2. The truck welcomed more than 250,000 visitors in total across its tours in Malaysia and Singapore, receiving an enthusiastic response from fans. Now, fans in the Philippines can look forward to experiencing “Pokémon Pokopia” on Nintendo Switch 2 at participating malls across the metro.
From October 2 to January 24, 2027, the Pokémon Truck will visit malls across Metro Manila, inviting shoppers to step into the world of “Pokémon Pokopia” and try the game on Nintendo Switch 2.

The Pokemon Truck will feature fun activities for fans of Pokemon and other Nintendo Switch titles including Donkey Kong and Mario Kart. Apart from getting to play game demos, participants can also join coloring activities and photo booths. Sticker giveaways and Pokemon visors (Pikachu, Ditto, and Peakychu) will also be given away.
